<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
    public function __get($name) { echo "BAD-GET;"; return 0; }
};
echo isset($o->no, $o->yes) ? "BAD;" : "SHORT;";
echo isset($o->yes) ? "YES;" : "BAD;";

<?php
class MissingIssetPairThrow {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        global $saved;
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        $name = "changed";
        $GLOBALS["o"] = null;
        throw $saved;
    }
    public function __get($name) { echo "BAD-GET;"; return 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "D;"; }
}
$saved = new Exception("kept");
$o = new MissingIssetPairThrow;
$result = 42;
try {
    $result = isset($o->missing);
} catch (Exception $caught) {
    echo $caught === $saved ? "SAME;" : "BAD;";
}
echo $result === 42 ? "UNCHANGED;" : "BAD;";
echo $o === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD;";
